title: Logos 11 opening: consubstantial — 'the Father is greater than I'
english: Eleventh discourse. Consubstantial again, with John 14:28 (“the Father is greater than I”) in view.
“Greater” is read without unlikeness of nature; the Son remains of the Father’s own substance.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Condensed lemma-led tip.
No Greystone wording. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
